tasks.title: Setup PostgreSQL database and create users and tasks tables with indexes
Build Node.js/Express REST API with endpoints for task CRUD operations and user authentication
Create React project structure and implement routing for all 6 screens
Implement Task List View screen with task cards, FAB button, and bottom navigation
Build Create Task modal with form validation and API integration
Implement task completion functionality with checkbox interaction and timestamp tracking
Create Delete Confirmation dialog and implement task deletion with API calls
Build Completed Tasks screen with filtering and clear all functionality
Implement Task Detail screen with edit mode and status updates
Create User Profile screen with statistics display and settings navigation
Apply color scheme, typography, and responsive design across all components
Implement animations, transitions, and accessibility features including WCAG compliance
Add error handling, loading states, and toast notifications throughout the app
Conduct end-to-end testing of all user flows and fix critical bugs

risks: Database connection issues or schema migration failures could block all development
API authentication implementation may take longer than estimated delaying frontend integration
Complex state management for task filtering and real-time updates could introduce bugs
Responsive design across different mobile devices may require additional testing time
Scope creep from adding non-MVP features like notifications or task sharing
